name: Address Processor
description: Search API processor that indexes the human-readable country name of Address fields so users can search addresses by country name rather than ISO code.
project_description:
Address Processor 
 Introduction 
 The Address Processor module provides functionality to process and index country names from address fields. This is particularly useful for integrating address data with search systems powered by the Search API module. By indexing country names, you can enable better filtering and searching capabilities in your Drupal website.

 Dependencies 
 Address

Search API

 Features 
 Extract and index the country name from address fields.

Fully compatible with Search API for enhanced search integration.

Simple configuration and seamless integration with existing address fields.

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further

information, see

Ensure that the Address and Search API modules are enabled.

 Usage 
 Navigate to the Search API configuration and edit your index.

Add address field and tick checkbox "Address processor".

Reindex your data
